newsitem.title: USA: Top Source to recruit CEO, Landow to remain.
newsitem.headline: Top Source to recruit CEO, Landow to remain.

text.p: Top Source Technologies Inc said Friday that its board has decided it would best serve shareholder interest by adding a new chief executive from outside the company.
The company said Stuart Landow will remain as president and chief executive until a candidate is found and then will remain as chairman.
In August the company has posted widening losses in recent quarters, including third quarter losses of $0.02 per share compared to a $0.01 per share loss in the 1995 third quarter.
